assumptions.statement: Write volume will stay within the projected ~1,800 writes/second that a single well‑tuned Postgres primary can sustain
assumptions.quote: Current peak load is roughly 600 ledger writes per second ... the 18-month projection ... tops out around 1,800 writes per second, which is comfortably within what a single well‑tuned Postgres primary can sustain.

assumptions.statement: The system will remain single‑region (us‑east‑1) with no need for a second region in the planning horizon
assumptions.quote: All payment processing runs in us-east-1, and there is no plan for a second region within the planning horizon.

assumptions.statement: Finance month‑end reporting can continue on the same database with only minor query rewrites
assumptions.quote: Finance's month‑end close runs a set of about 40 SQL reports ... has asked that they keep working with minimal rewrites; the close has to finish inside two business days.

assumptions.statement: A two‑engineer team without a dedicated DBA can operate and maintain an RDS PostgreSQL instance
assumptions.quote: Small team: two backend engineers, no dedicated DBA.
